It also includes a footnote reference and explicitly states that the authors should "more explicitly describe these works and provide examples of how their work aims to improve on them." This is an explicit action, but the comment does not provide concrete details on how to implement it: it never specifies which related works should be described, what kinds of examples would be appropriate, or where/how to integrate this discussion into the paper. The comment explicitly states what action to take but is vague on how to execute it, matching the rubric level that covers explicit but vague actions.
